why: phase-492 (2026-10-13) -- not user API. `nros_cpp_node_bind_c` / `nros_cpp_node_t` are the C++ binding's seam that `RCLC_C_COMPONENT` expands to: the generated entry hosts a C component on the C++ binding's context and binds the component's `rcl_node_t` / `rclc_executor_t` to it (W4). They reach the C parity surface only because `<rclc/rclc.h>` now includes `<rclc/component.h>`, so `<rclc/rclc.h>` carries `RCLC_C_COMPONENT` and C user code needs no `<nros/*.h>` include. A user never writes either name; they keep `nros_cpp_` as seam names (c-api-rename-map class `seam`).
